name: Macron
verdict: Italian sportswear maker whose majority shareholder is Andrea Pignataro, the founder of the financial-software group ION Group. Nothing found.
note: Kit supplier to Al-Diriyah, and Deportivo Alavés' kit maker from 2026-27 (previously Puma). Al-Taawoun replaced Macron with Offside for 2026-27 (club announcement 2026-06-29).
